events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele broke a tie with 8:13 left with his second goal of the game, Connor Hellebuyck made 30 saves and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Los Angeles Kings 3-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mark Scheifele scores twice in the Jets' 3-2 victory over the Kings

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — Jake Neighbours scored two goals to lead the St. Louis Blues to a 4-2 win over the Calgary Flames on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Neighbours scores twice as Blues beat Flames 4-2

headlines.description: — Jeremy Swayman made 21 saves, Pavel Zacha, Mark Kastelic and Sean Kuraly scored and the Boston Bruins beat the Buffalo Sabres 3-1 on Saturday night to run their season-opening winning streak to three.
headlines.shortLinkText: Swayman makes 22 saves, Bruins beat Sabres 3-1 to improve to 3-0

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Lucas Raymond scored twice, including the 100th goal of his career, and the Detroit Red Wings pulled away to a 6-3 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raymond's 100th career goal lifts Red Wings past Maple Leafs, 6-3

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Connor Brown scored twice, Nico Hischier and Timo Meier each had a goal and two an assist, and the New Jersey Devils beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 5-3 on Saturday night for their first win of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Brown scores 2 goals as Devils beat Lightning 5-3 for 1st win

headlines.description: — Brad Marchand, Aaron Ekblad and Anton Lundell all finished with a goal and an assist, and the Florida Panthers stayed unbeaten by topping the Ottawa Senators 6-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers beat Senators to remain unbeaten, roll to 6-2 victory for 3-0-0 start

events.name: Washington Capitals at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Aliaksei Protas had two goals and an assist, and the Washington Capitals beat New York 4-2 on Saturday night, spoiling the Islanders’ home opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Protas has 2 goals and an assist as Capitals beat Islanders 4-2

events.name: New York Rangers at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Adam Fox scored twice and added an assist as the New York Rangers beat the Penguins 6-1 on Saturday night to give new coach Mike Sullivan a victory in his return to Pittsburgh.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adam Fox leads Rangers past Penguins 6-1 in coach Mike Sullivan's return to Pittsburgh

headlines.description: — Kaiden Guhle scored with 15.7 seconds left, and the Montreal Canadiens spoiled Chicago's home opener with a 3-2 victory over the Blackhawks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guhle scores late goal as Montreal spoils Chicago's home opener with 3-2 win

headlines.description: — Dylan Guenther scored at 2:56 of overtime and the Utah Mammoth rallied for a 3-2 win over the Nashville Predators on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guenther scores in OT as Mammoth beat Predators 3-2

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Minnesota Wild

headlines.description: — Kirill Marchenko had his fourth career hat trick and Elvis Merzlikins made 48 saves in his season debut, carrying the Columbus Blue Jackets past Minnesota 7-4 to spoil the Wild's home opener on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchenko's hat trick and Merzlikins' 48 saves help Blue Jackets spoil Wild home opener with 7-4 win

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson and Mikko Rantanen scored shootout goals, Jake Oettinger stopped Nathan MacKinnon on Colorado’s final shot, and the Dallas Stars beat the Avalanche 5-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rantanen, Robertson score in shootout, Stars top Avs, 5-4

headlines.description: — Noah Philp and Andrew Mangiapane scored in the second period, and the Edmonton Oilers beat the Vancouver Canucks 3-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Philp, Mangiapane score in 2nd period as Oilers beat Canucks 3-1

events.name: Anaheim Ducks at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Leo Carlsson scored 46 seconds into overtime and the Anaheim Ducks overcame a two-goal, third-period deficit to for a 7-6 win over the San Jose Sharks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ducks rally to stun Sharks 7-6 in OT

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Jared McCann score with 3.8 seconds left in overtime, lifting the Seattle Kraken to a 2-1 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCann scores with 3.8 seconds left in OT, Kraken beat Golden Knights 2-1
